name: crm-clinicas
description: CRM para clínicas de estética e emagrecimento

scripts.build: npm run build -w @crm/shared && npm run build -w @crm/api && npm run build -w @crm/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @crm/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @crm/api" "npm run dev -w @crm/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @crm/shared && npm run dev -w @crm/api
scripts.preview:api: npm run build -w @crm/shared && npm run preview -w @crm/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @crm/shared && npm run typecheck -w @crm/api && npm run typecheck -w @crm/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @crm/shared && npm run test -w @crm/api
scripts.db:generate: npm run build -w @crm/shared && npm run db:generate -w @crm/api
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @crm/shared && npm run db:migrate -w @crm/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @crm/shared && npm run db:seed -w @crm/api
scripts.db:studio: npm run build -w @crm/shared && npm run db:studio -w @crm/api
